name: Stomp
description: Arm your next jump so the landing releases a 3-block shockwave that damages and knocks enemies away from the impact point

name: Aftershock
description: Release an 8-block spherical aftershock that damages, pushes, and staggers enemies from the center

name: Sinkhole
description: Bury enemy, dealing suffocation damage

name: Iron Wall
description: Create barrier, heal 10% HP

name: Metal Coat
description: Coat yourself in dark shiny metal, reducing all incoming damage by 50%

name: Alloy Enhancement
description: Prime the next physical melee weapon or tool for three no-durability uses with 30% bonus effect

name: Lava Pool
description: Create a caster-centered lava pool that burns enemies while protecting the caster and allies

name: Obsidian Skin
description: Root yourself in a short lava tower, then gain a dark obsidian coating with shield and damage reduction

name: Magma Sling
description: Fire a small molten projectile that burns the direct target and splashes nearby enemies

name: Rubble Rouser
description: Coat your whole body in stone and empower the next bare-fist hit with a rubble burst

name: Pillar Strike
description: Rapidly stack a 1x1x4 stone pillar at an enemy or ground point, launching and stunning enemies

name: Rockslide
description: Dash forward through enemies, pushing them aside while rocks, dirt, and debris kick up underfoot

name: Rooted
description: Root yourself in place, heal immediately, and regenerate while wrapped in roots

name: Vines
description: Entangle the enemy with thorny vines

name: Sapling
description: Fire a seed that lands on the ground, raises an emerald temple statue with pink glow, lures enemies, and pulses healing

name: Nightshade
description: Launch a nightshade seed that blooms into a poisonous lure

name: Frolick
description: Dance among flowers, healing and gaining speed while leaving a temporary mixed flower trail

name: Cacti Cluster
description: Launch a heavy cactus cluster that sticks, poisons, slows, then bursts

name: Gargoyle
description: Become an ancient statue, heal, become untargetable, and heavily reduce incoming damage while locked in place

name: Glare
description: Petrifying gaze that stuns for 2 turns

name: Tunnel
description: Burrow underground and strike from below

name: Burrow
description: Emerge from the ground in a devastating strike

name: Mudpit
description: Trap the enemy in sticky mud

name: Debris
description: Fling debris that blinds and weakens

name: Sandstorm
description: Conjure a blinding sandstorm that damages over time

name: Dust Devil
description: Spin up a dust devil that knocks back

name: Vitrification
description: Superheated sand burns the enemy

name: Lapidary
description: Place a persistent green gem cube that can be recalled and acts as the anchor for Gem abilities

name: Fracture
description: Shatter the active gem in a fast expanding green crystal burst

name: Refraction
description: Project a bright green light aura around the active gem that boosts allies inside it

name: Frozen Needles
description: Rapid ice shards, stacking slow

name: Stalactite Crash
description: Heavy ice impact with explosion

name: Skate
description: Gain 50% evasion for 2 turns

name: Snow Imp
description: Summon minion that attacks each turn

name: Snowstorm
description: Slow enemy attack speed for 3 turns

name: Frosty
description: Summon a yeti that taunts and absorbs damage

name: High Tide
description: Push enemy back, gain speed

name: Waverider
description: Gain shield and speed for 2 turns

name: Riptide
description: Pull enemy in, increase damage taken

name: Piercing Rain
description: Acidic rain that damages over time and speeds attacks

name: Rainbow
description: Summon a healing rainbow that restores HP

name: Splash
description: Splash water that damages and creates a shield

name: Scald
description: Scorch with boiling water, burning and knocking back

name: Geyser
description: Erupt a geyser of scalding water

name: Overheat
description: Supercharge attacks but burn yourself

name: Vapor Vanish
description: Dissolve into mist for 50% evasion

name: Dispersion
description: Reform from vapor in a quick strike

name: Hidrosis
description: Coat yourself in moisture for enhanced dodging

name: Ice Cap
description: Encase in ice for a shield and freeze attacker

name: Glacier
description: Conjure glacial armor for damage reduction

name: Ice Shelf
description: Crush enemy with a massive ice shelf

name: Tide Pool
description: Create a tide pool that speeds you and slows enemy

name: Abyssal Assist
description: Call upon deep-sea pressure to stun and weaken

name: Rip Current
description: Drag the enemy with a powerful current

name: Leap Frog
description: Leap and strike, leaving the enemy vulnerable

name: River Rapids
description: Ride the rapids to gain speed and momentum

name: Swamp Monster
description: Summon a creature from the swamp to fight

name: Bilge Dump
description: Dump foul bilge water that poisons and slows

name: Anchor Haul
description: Haul an anchor across the enemy for heavy damage

name: Oil Spill
description: Coat yourself in protective oil for defense

name: Shriek
description: Deafen enemy, reduce their accuracy

name: Sonic Boom
description: Shockwave that stuns

name: Battle Cry
description: Rally yourself and nearby allies with a sonic battle cry, granting +15% damage and +10% speed.

name: Jet Burst
description: Burst in the aimed direction, displacing enemies you pass without dealing damage.

name: Afterburner
description: Accelerate with jet-fire trailing behind you for 8 seconds; enemies touching the trail burn.

name: Mach Punch
description: Powerful strike after dash

name: Thunderclap
description: Release a point-blank thunder shockwave that stuns enemies for 3.5 seconds.

name: Smite
description: Call down a crosshair-aimed lightning strike with a 3x3 impact footprint.

name: Chain Lightning
description: Chain lightning through up to six targets, jumping only to the closest target within 3 blocks.

name: Twister
description: Send a smaller tornado forward, swirling enemies near the ground with light lift.

name: Funnel Cloud
description: Create a large funnel cloud that pulls enemies inward and lifts them up to 12 blocks if space allows.

name: Eye of the Storm
description: Create a caster-centered storm zone that protects allies while slowing and damaging enemies.

name: Leap
description: Arm your next jump for 5 seconds, making it 60% higher with forward boost and no damage.

name: Divebomb
description: While airborne, dive into an aimed ground impact that damages and knocks enemies away.

name: Hang Time
description: Float in the air for 3 seconds, drifting slightly until canceled by jump or another movement ability.

name: Air Slash
description: Fire a 3-block-wide sideways pale-yellow cutting wind arc that pierces enemies.

name: Gale Cutter
description: Fire two crossing pale-yellow wind slashes in an X formation that pierce enemies.

name: Razor Wind
description: Perform five rapid little wind slashes against enemies in front of you.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Throw a smoke bomb that creates a 5-block cloud for 6 seconds, blinding and slowing enemies.

name: Vanish
description: Vanish in smoke for 3 seconds; attacking or casting a damaging ability ends it early.

name: Smoke Form
description: Become smoke, move through enemies, and reduce projectile damage by 50% without terrain noclip.

name: Gust
description: Blast enemies with a crosshair-aimed gust that pushes and disorients them.

name: Cyclone Shield
description: Surround yourself with a tight cyclone, reducing projectile damage by 65% and all damage by 10%.

name: Tempest
description: Place a storm field that pulls, slows, and repeatedly hits enemies caught inside.

name: Air Shot
description: Fire a fast compressed-air projectile that travels 15 blocks.

name: Bullet Storm
description: Fire a rapid volley of compressed-air bullets that each travel 15 blocks.

name: Pressure Burst
description: Charge up to 4 seconds, then fire a larger fast compressed-air shot up to 20 blocks.

name: Smog
description: Create a lingering toxic cloud that damages, slows, and weakens enemies.

name: Toxic Breath
description: Exhale a 60-degree cone of toxic breath up to 8 blocks, applying poison and vulnerability for 5 seconds.

name: Acid Rain
description: Call acidic green rain at the target area for 6 seconds, damaging and weakening enemies.

name: Fireball
description: Explosive fire, applies burn

name: Ignite
description: Set self on fire, damage nearby enemies

name: Combust
description: Consume burns for massive damage

name: Raise Dead
description: Summon one stronger undead ally that follows you and attacks hostile mobs.

name: Life Drain
description: Channel a dark tether for 4 seconds, damaging the target each second and healing for 50% of actual damage dealt.

name: Death Mark
description: Mark one enemy for 8 seconds, making them take 20% more damage; death triggers a small enemy-only dark explosion.

name: Shadow Step
description: Blink forward a fixed safe distance, leaving dark smoke at the start and end points.

name: Umbral Veil
description: Wrap yourself in black-purple wisps, becoming hard to target and reducing incoming damage until you attack.

name: Dark Embrace
description: Wrap yourself or a targeted ally/summon in dark protection, granting damage reduction and small healing over time.

name: Hellfire
description: Breathe blue hellfire in a cone in front of you, burning and slowing enemies.

name: Infernal Ground
description: Set blue infernal ground ablaze under the caster; enemies burn, friendlies are safe.

name: Soul Scorch
description: Wrap one target in blue soul-fire, dealing damage over time and increasing damage taken.

name: Dominate
description: Dominate a single enemy permanently until toggled off or the target dies; dominated targets become friendly allies.

name: Mind Shatter
description: Create a bright pink 6-block psychic explosion centered on your dominated ally if present, otherwise on you.

name: Hivemind
description: Control all enemies within 7 blocks for 6 seconds; Mind Shatter can detonate each controlled target.

name: Imbue: Power
description: Self-only dark red imbuement that boosts damage; replaces other imbuements.

name: Imbue: Fortitude
description: Self-only dark green imbuement that boosts damage reduction; replaces other imbuements.

name: Imbue: Swiftness
description: Self-only bright yellow imbuement that boosts movement and attack speed; replaces other imbuements.

name: Sanctuary
description: Place a holy circle that heals and protects friendlies while lightly weakening enemies.

name: Absorb
description: Create a caster-only white-gold shield that absorbs damage and converts part of it into healing.

name: Purify
description: Cleanse negative effects from friendlies in a radius and burst white-gold damage into enemies.

name: Rift
description: Open a black-purple void tear that pulls and slows enemies.

name: Void Spawn
description: Summon three friendly Crawler_Void allies in a triangle around you for 10 seconds.

name: Consume
description: Consume a target with void damage, healing yourself; targets below 10% health are executed.

name: Scarak Egg
description: Place Deco_Scarak_Eggsacks; after 4 seconds it hatches into friendly Scarak Seeker and Fighter summons.

name: Brood Surge
description: Instantly hatch active Scarak eggs and grant Scarak summons +40% movement speed for 6 seconds.

name: Locust Queen
description: Summon a friendly Scarak fighter queen proxy directly for 20 seconds.

name: Pterodactyl Form
description: Transform into Pterodactyl for 30 seconds. Hold Space to fly; form abilities are Swoop and Carry On.

name: Triceratops Form
description: Transform into Trillodon for 30 seconds. Stampede breaks forward and Horn Guard protects nearby allies.

name: T-Rex Form
description: Transform into Rex_Cave for 30 seconds. Crushing Bite executes low-health enemies and Primal Roar fears foes.
